verdict.rationale: Forter documents an Order API (v3) that merchants call at checkout to receive a fraud or abuse decision [forter-docs-1]. A separate order-status API reports payment authorization afterward [forter-docs-2], which implies the decision call comes before authorization. The evidence describes a decision rather than an explicit machine-learning risk score, and never states the call is synchronous or gives latency figures, so the story is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit ML risk score values in the response, documented synchronous/pre-authorization timing and latency guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.
